name: release-notes-drafter
description: Chrome extension that drafts grouped release notes from merged pull requests on GitHub.

scripts.check: node --check src/core.js && node --check src/content.js && node --check src/background.js && node --check src/popup.js && node --check tools/gen-icons.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8'))" && echo 'syntax ok'
